identityReview: Mette Frederiksen, born November 19, 1977 in Aalborg. Bachelor 2007 and African-studies master 2009, no doctorate. LO youth work before first Folketing election November 20, 2001. Employment minister October 3, 2011–October 10, 2014, justice minister October 10, 2014–June 28, 2015, Social Democratic leader from June 28, 2015, prime minister from June 27, 2019. Second cabinet December 15, 2022; third June 3, 2026 after March 24 election and June 1 coalition announcement. Current minority coalition is S–SF–M–RV, not old S–V–M. Not a Danish monarch, directly elected president, EU official or the similarly named Norwegian royal.

A separately read public Ritzau preview dated November 13 records her actual Thursday November 12 comments and arrival at Dublin EPC. Danish advance travel and visitor schedules are only corroborative context, not standalone attendance evidence. Full subscriber article and original videos not reviewed.
